title: palette_load's inline jcol default for route_tie (3rd ODN-5 mirror site) has zero test coverage
detail: ODN-5 names three canonical mirror sites; the byte pin covers two. A mutation of only the jcol default (e.g. reverting to amber) passes every test and silently resurfaces the tie/congested collision when the JSON token is absent.
recommended_fix: Add an expect_color leg loading a palette source with route_tie stripped, pinning the jcol default {186,94,232,235} like the other two sites.

title: draw_tie_mark's new degenerate guard (r1 N7) is happy-path-only — no negative test exercises the early return
detail: New defensive branch with no failing-mode coverage; a regression that removes or inverts the guard (e.g. drawing with negative radii) passes all tests. Sibling draw_ring_annulus guard is likewise untested.
recommended_fix: Extend palcheck §5 (or a unit extraction) with a zero-scale/zero-alpha frame asserting zero tie-colored pixels — the guard then provably bites.

title: W1 derive-script reproducibility fix has no automated gate — strip_jsonc_comments and the new oracle pair run only on manual invocation
evidence:
tools/lint.sh gate inventory (lines 89-98) invokes only:
if ! python3 tools/test_sprite_order.py; then
if ! python3 tools/test_sprite_foldin.py; then

tools/ci-local.sh's palette gate is only: "Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle — 7.1)|tools/harness.sh palcheck" — derive_a11y_palettes.py appears in no script (repo-wide grep: only the file itself).
detail: The W1 fix works today (verified: `python3 tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py` exits 0, all pairs clear, on shipped bytes), but nothing re-runs it; a regression to bare json.load or a broken stripper surfaces only at the next manual derivation.
recommended_fix: Add a lint.sh gate running derive_a11y_palettes.py (exit-code check), and/or a test_sprite_order-style python unit test for strip_jsonc_comments incl. in-string '//' preservation.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence: Key coverage lines read: palette_polish_test.odin — "testing.expectf(t, on == SPAWN_RING_SEGS / 2, \"dash duty cycle must be 1/2 (on=%d of %d)\", on, SPAWN_RING_SEGS)"; palcheck §5 — "check(mismatch == 0 && drawn == rnd.SPAWN_RING_SEGS / 2, fmt.aprintf(\"tie ring drawn set == tie_dash_on (drawn %d of %d, mismatches %d — a solid-ring revert renders the full fan)\"...)"; byte pins "expect_color(t, p.route_tie, {186, 94, 232, 235})" on load + fallback; unremapped check "check(eff.route_tie == base.route_tie ...)" x3 modes; a11y pair "append(&pairs, [2]rl.Color{p.route_tie, p.state_congested})"; oracle negative leg a11y_oracle_bites_on_poison.
detail: P0 (shipped de-conflict path: data token, draw path, mode tables) 100% — unit byte/hue pins + integration pixel-scan + mutation legs recorded. P1 (canon pins: 6-tier >=15deg, >=90deg congested, duty cycle, enumeration equality) ~100%. Overall ~82% (11/14 units FULL, 1 PARTIAL, 2 NONE — all in degraded/dev-tool paths).
recommended_fix: Close the three open items: jcol-default byte pin, degenerate-guard negative leg, and a lint.sh invocation of derive_a11y_palettes.py.
